answer: Proof of Personhood via decentralized identity registries mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring cryptographic stakes or social graph attestations. Like a lone climber reaching a summit, an agent must validate its uniqueness to access high-value network resources. Without this verified identity, an attacker faces the cost of provisioning vast computational infrastructure, a task as futile as building a wharf in an empty meadow. This barrier forces the cost of multiple identities beyond the potential profit margin.
